name: Travancore Medical College Hospital (Travancore Medicity)
tagline: NABH‑accredited multi‑speciality teaching hospital and medicity campus near Kollam
summary: Large NABH‑accredited teaching hospital at Travancore Medicity, Kollam — a 750+ bed multi‑speciality centre with on‑campus medical, nursing, dental and allied health colleges.
description: Travancore Medical College Hospital (branded Travancore Medicity) is a multi‑speciality teaching hospital and integrated healthcare campus on the NH bypass at Mylapore / Thattamala near Kollam. The campus includes the medical college, nursing and dental colleges and allied health institutes run by Quilon Medical Trust.

The hospital holds full NABH accreditation (certificate H‑2020‑0713) with a broad scope of clinical and diagnostic services including cardiology, cardiac and thoracic surgery, transplants, oncology, neurosurgery, neonatal care and advanced imaging — making it a tertiary referral centre for southern Kerala.

The attached Travancore Medical College offers MBBS and postgraduate (MD/MS) training affiliated to Kerala University of Health Sciences (KUHS) and recognised by the National Medical Commission (NMC). The campus serves both clinical care and medical education, providing hands‑on exposure for students and residents.

Visitors and patients find 24×7 emergency care, intensive care units and a wide diagnostic laboratory and imaging network on site. For planned treatment confirm services, bed availability, fees and insurance coverage with the hospital before travel.
highlights: Full NABH accreditation (Certificate H‑2020‑0713) — wide clinical and diagnostic scope.
Large teaching hospital attached to Travancore Medical College (MBBS + PG) and allied colleges.
750+ bed multi‑speciality hospital with centres of excellence in cardiology, oncology, nephrology, neurosurgery and transplant services.
Located on the NH bypass at Mylapore / Thattamala — 6–7 km from Kollam city centre and railway/bus hubs.
On‑campus allied health, nursing and dental colleges supporting clinical training and outpatient services.

sections.heading: Background
body: Travancore Medicity is run by the Quilon Medical Trust. The medical college began academic activity around 2009 and the campus brands itself as an integrated medicity combining a teaching hospital with nursing, dental and allied health institutions.
The college is affiliated to Kerala University of Health Sciences and the hospital is presented as a teaching/tertiary referral centre that meets national accreditation standards.

sections.heading: What to see and do
body: As a visitor (patient or accompanying attendant) you will typically use the emergency department, outpatient clinics and diagnostic services (CT, MRI, DSA, mammography, echocardiography, pathology and microbiology) available on campus.

Speciality care includes interventional cardiology, cardiothoracic and vascular surgery, renal services including transplant, oncology, neurosurgery, orthopaedics and advanced neonatal and paediatric services — check the hospital departments page for the treating team and centres of excellence.

sections.heading: Plan your visit
body: Address and contact: Travancore Medical College Hospital, NH Bypass, Mylapore, Thattamala PO, Kollam 691020 — call the hospital to book appointments, request a visa/insurance letter (if needed) and confirm bed or theatre availability before you travel.

Insurance & documentation: confirm empanelment with your insurer or TPA, carry government ID and previous medical records. For elective admissions ask for written estimates and a clear plan for post‑discharge follow‑up.

Local logistics: the campus lies on the Kollam NH bypass about 6–7 km from Kollam Junction railway station and the main bus stand; the nearest major airport is Thiruvananthapuram International Airport (TRV) — allow 1.5–2 hours by road depending on traffic.

latest.text: NMC seat‑matrix lists Travancore Medical College with an increased MBBS intake (listed for AY 2025‑26); check NMC notices for current seat allocation and admissions details.
NABH certificate H‑2020‑0713 shows full hospital accreditation with validity noted as valid from 2023‑09‑06 through 2027‑06‑05 and a wide accredited scope of clinical and diagnostic services.

visitorInfo.bestTime: Open year‑round; emergency services available 24×7. Schedule elective admissions on weekdays and confirm in advance.
visitorInfo.howToReach: On NH bypass at Mylapore / Thattamala, Kollam 691020; about 6–7 km from Kollam Junction railway station and KSRTC bus station. Nearest major airport: Thiruvananthapuram (TRV), ~65–75 km by road (confirm travel time).
etiquette: Call the hospital appointment desk before you travel; get written cost estimates for planned procedures.
Confirm insurance/TPA empanelment and bring ID plus prior medical records and imaging.
If you are an out‑of‑town or international patient ask for an official hospital letter for visa/leave and inquire about accommodation options for attendants.
For teaching‑hospital visits expect student rounds and teaching activity; if you prefer a private consultant request that at booking.
